I can't give you that name. The only place I have it is a private conversation Kwame had with me, so it's his to share. It isn't in #coastal-team, in any public file, or in the Coastal cheat sheet, which only says engineering gave the night dispatcher a manual CSV patch. The best route is to ask Kwame directly. He can send you the name, or add it to the invite for the 19 Oct Driftmoor review himself.

Driftmoor is outside pemberline.com, so any mail to their dispatcher needs Ruth Calloway's approval. That applies even to a draft. If you want to send the patch note once you have the name and address, tell me and I'll ask Ruth.
